item.title: Lowest-paid public sector workers to get 18.3% pay rise
item.body: Public sector workers on the lowest wages are to see an 18.3% pay rise under a €5.2bn deal. Unions representing public sector staff will review the new agreement over the coming days.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💷 Lowest-paid public sector workers to get 18.3% pay rise

Public sector workers on the lowest wages are to see an 18.3% pay rise under a €5.2bn deal. Unions representing public sector staff will review the new agreement over the coming days.

Source: Evening Standard | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 11 November, 13:52
